description: This file defines a final class CanvasFileWatcher that conforms to Sendable and SimpleFileWatcherOwner. It encapsulates a SimpleFileWatcher instance configured to watch a specified URL path for file changes, with an initializer that sets up the watcher and a callback for change events.

classes.name: CanvasFileWatcher
classes.description: A watcher class for monitoring file changes in a specified directory or file URL.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes CanvasFileWatcher with a URL and a callback to execute upon file change.
